steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Roman family (familia) included everyone under the paterfamilias's authority — wife, children, slaves and dependants | Key Fact: Patria potestas gave the father legal power over his children for life, even after they were adults | Key Fact: Roman women could not vote or hold political office but managed households and could own and inherit property | Key Fact: Marriage was typically arranged for political or economic reasons — the minimum age was 12 for girls
